content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd (CSC) has released the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026 notification for recruitment to the Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator - District post on a contract basis for one year. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for Chhatarpur and Sidhi districts of Madhya Pradesh, with 1 vacancy in each district. The applications are invited through online mode, and eligible candidates can apply on or before 08 October 2026. content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not lay out a separate post-application selection process. Instead, candidates are required to already hold a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate before applying. This certificate is obtained through: Aadhaar Supervisor Exam - taken via the UIDAI exam portal after State Team authorization. Aadhaar LMS Certification - completed once the LMS ID and password are created and approved. No further selection stages (such as interview or document verification) are mentioned in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract-basis (1-year) recruitment by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd for the post of Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator at Aadhaar Seva Kendras, currently open for districts in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 2 vacancies - 1 in Chhatarpur and 1 in Sidhi, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary), OR Matriculation + 2 Years ITI, OR Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma, along with a valid UIDAI-authorized Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate and basic computer skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years or above. No upper limit is specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: The application mode is not specified in the provided notification. Candidates must first obtain the Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate via the exam and LMS links given above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates must already hold the UIDAI-authorized certification obtained via the Aadhaar Supervisor Exam and LMS Certification; no additional selection stages are mentioned.
